{{Quote|I'm your man, General.|Unidentified male Pop-Dog captain to Stavin Thaal|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite unit of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]]. He served in communications before switching to public relations, and had never served in combat.<ref name="MK" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]] and was aboard Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]'s [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]], giving him the news of the destruction of six [[E-wing starfighter|E-wings]] and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gidders]]' [[Gidders's shuttle|shuttle]] on [[Chakham Army Base]] by two unidentified [[X-wing starfighter|X-wings]]. The captain also narrated the findings concerning the [[Embass suit|carcass]] of Embassy-Who-Climbs, an unidentified species that had reached out to the Pop-Dogs. Unbeknowst to them, both events were orchestrated by [[Wraith Squadron]], a recently reformed Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, on a [[Hunt for Stavin Thaal|mission]] to prove the corrupt activities of Thaal.<ref name="MK" />

When the famous pop [[Musician/Legends|singer]] [[Ledina Chott]] was found unconscious inside the [[Major Saving's Army Surplus]] store in [[Kura City]], which served as the entrance to a storage area for Thaal's [[Black market/Legends|black market]] activities, Thaal gave the captain and his [[Stavin Thaal's driver|driver]] an ultimatum: they had to reaffirm their absolute loyalty to him in exchange for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|monetary]] rewards in the future. Both gave their assent, and Thaal gave the captain a [[credcard]] and ordered him to utilize his public relation skills and use it to spread information that Thaal's inspection on the planet was intended to investigate rumors about Gidders trafficking in the black market.<ref name="MK" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|One more hesitation and I bust you to enlisted man.|Stavin Thaal to Unidentified male Pop-Dog captain|<ref name="MK" />}}
The captain was a timid person that disliked giving bad news, often hesitating or wincing as he delivered them. Thaal viewed him as someone who did not have the gumption to kill a [[game fowl]] to feed his troops.<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The male Pop-Dog captain was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for his [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the tenth volume in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series.<ref name="MK" />
